title: UI+docs: Fix Wiresharkisms in Stratoshark's help and man page
description:
Make the output of `stratoshark --help` more specific to Stratoshark.
Update the Stratoshark man page to match.

Fixes #20229

notes.body: Can you change this (for both applications) without changing ui/capture_opts.c:set_autostop_criterion() ?
`set_autostop_criterion` handles "packets" and "events". I updated this to match.
Can you change this (for both applications) without changing ui/capture_opts.c:get_ring_arguments() ?

I updated `get_ring_arguments` to handle "packets" and "events" similar to `set_autostop_criterion` handles and updated this to match. I also noted that we should probably disable ring buffer output for Stratoshark, since libscap probably won't support it any time soon.
